category_title: Students who engage in disruptive behaviors to avoid nonpreferred writing tasks
student_description: Mike is an 8-year-old second grader who frequently engages in disruptive and hyperactive behaviors (e.g., tapping, wandering, calling out) to avoid independent writing tasks. He does not respond to standard verbal redirects or adult assistance; instead, he uniquely requires structured task escape, visual self-monitoring tools, choice-making, and group-based reinforcement to successfully engage and complete his work.

criteria.rationale: Mike frequently seeks peer attention through disruption; a group contingency channels this need positively by making his success beneficial to his classmates.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must establish a system where Mike's appropriate behavior or task completion earns a specific reward or positive reinforcement for the entire class or peer group.
